maria-ml: Quick heads-up: running a 6h streaming tool-loop soak on Dedicated and seeing steady RSS drift. KV resident bytes keep climbing while total keys stay flat.
aj: repro + numbers?
maria-ml: repro command: `./tools/soak_long_tool_loop --iters 30000 --stream`
Start RSS ~3.1GB, 2h ~3.9GB, 6h ~6.0GB. KV keys stable ~98k. Eviction counter ticks but resident grows.
kevin: can you paste eviction/allocator metrics snapshot?
maria-ml: pasted trimmed metrics:```
kv_total_keys=98_412
kv_resident_bytes=6_001_234_560
kv_evictions=11_820
kv_paged_out=24_150
slab_allocated=6_800_000_000
slab_free=520_000_000
fragmentation_percent=18.1
```
aj: evictions + resident growth suggests freed pages aren't returned to OS or there are live refs preventing eviction. Did you check jemalloc stats or /proc/<pid>/smaps?
maria-ml: yes. smaps shows anon mappings growing; anon_hugepage region increases over time. jemalloc shows arena retained pages not returned.
devon: also possible: session-level retention holds references to KV pages via stream output buffers. Long streaming tool outputs append chunks that keep page refs alive until cleared.
kevin: any heap profile diffs? pprof top alloc types?
maria-ml: heap diff (4h vs 0h):```
58%  2.9GB  crate::kv::page::KVPageRef
22%  1.1GB  runtime::session::StreamingOutputBuffer
12%  600MB  runtime::session::CompletedToolOutput
```
maria-ml: notable: StreamingOutputBuffer grows per-session with long tool outputs.
aj: quick experiment: after each tool-call call `session.clear_completed_tool_outputs()` and rerun soak. If growth stops -> logical retention bug.
maria-ml: ran that change locally, growth plateaued after ~20m. Patch is a stopgap but strongly indicates session retention keeps KV pages live.
devon: hypothesis: outputs hold strong Arc/owned refs to KV backing pages. circular buffer/pop semantics might be off-by-one leaving a stale ref on buffer tail. Also fragmentation at ~18% means slabs keep warm pages.
kevin: options: 1) convert output->page strong refs to weak refs so eviction can reclaim pages, 2) add periodic compaction that returns unused slab pages to OS when fragmentation > threshold, 3) tighten session retention policy for streaming tool outputs.
aj: I'll try prototype converting strong->weak refs for long-lived streaming attachments and add unit tests around buffer wrap.
maria-ml: I'll add instrumentation to log per-page refcounts and emit warnings when refcount doesn't drop within X seconds after output cleared.
devon: I'll prototype a compaction pass that triggers when fragmentation_percent > 12% and runs during low load windows. Might help immediate memory pressure.
kevin: plan for verification: run dedicated soak with debug build, enable pprof heap snapshots every 15m, and collect jemalloc stats + /proc/smaps. I'll coord a run on canary.
maria-ml: filed PERF-2421 with traces + before/after heap diffs and the quick clear patch: https://redwood/internal/PERF-2421 (attached pprof tarballs).
aj: I'll open a small PR switching to weak refs for output->page links (WIP: branch kv/weak-output-refs). If CI green we can merge to canary for soak.
kevin: added canary job and a debug soak run. Also added a log hook to dump top 10 sessions by streaming buffer size every 10m.
runtime-ci-bot: Build passed for branch/kv/weak-output-refs (commit d4f2a1). :white_check_mark:
maria-ml: thanks, leaving soak running for another 2h. I'll post final pprof snapshots and smaps diffs when finished. :thumbsup:
